metaDescription: Order custom gold aprons for your team or event. Bulk pricing and fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gold aprons bring a touch of warmth and visibility to any workspace or event. Whether you're outfitting baristas, salon staff, or trade show teams, a gold base color helps your logo stand out while keeping a professional look. These aprons are available in cotton, polyester, and denim blends, with options for full-color screen printing or embroidery. Choose from bib, waist, or full-length styles to match your specific needs.
heroAltText: Custom gold aprons with embroidered logos for restaurant staff and event teams
